facts.form: Cls; Cls colour; Cls colour,x1,y1 To x2,y2
facts.finding: The definition says bare Cls fills the current screen with colour zero; the other forms choose a colour or rectangle.
Print accepts item lists; semicolons keep adjacent output and commas move to tab positions. A trailing separator changes the final cursor advance.

citation.anchor: PRINT or ? (Print a list of variables to the screen)

facts.finding: Waits for one keypress before the following statement.
Ends execution; the described choices are Space for the editor and Escape for direct mode.
The variable section describes assignment with equals and a dollar suffix for string variables.

facts.form: If condition Then statements Else statements
facts.finding: The inline form is limited to one line. Branching to a label requires an explicit Goto; otherwise the name is treated as a procedure.

citation.anchor: IF ... TH EN ... [E LS E] (Choose between alternative actions)

facts.finding: Structured tests contain instruction lists and may nest; the text forbids an ordinary If Then inside the structured test.
